description: Real bug (fixed in c76256de): on Windows config persist, the GitHub PAT plaintext is erased BEFORE confirming its DPAPI encryption succeeded, unlike the McpAuthToken field two lines below which guards the erase on encryption success. If ProtectSecretForConfig returns empty, the only copy of the PAT is lost.
delegationPacket: Review this diff to Source_Core/src/ConfigManager.cpp (Windows secret-persist path) for correctness bugs. Focus on data-loss / credential-safety. Report each finding with file:line, a severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), and a one-line summary.

dimensions.description: Did the agent identify the unconditional github_pat erase-before-encrypt data-loss bug and contrast it with the guarded mcp_auth_token pattern?

expectedFindings.summary: j.erase(github_pat) runs unconditionally before the DPAPI encrypt on the next line is confirmed non-empty; if ProtectSecretForConfig fails, the PAT is irrecoverably lost. The mcp_auth_token field below shows the correct guarded-erase pattern.

referenceOutcome.notes: Ground truth = fix commit c76256de (fix(github-tracker): apply 5 CodeRabbit findings missed on #357). repoRef 5c6e97fd is the buggy parent. Path is the historical Source_Core/ layout (later restructured to Source/Core/). One genuine finding.
